title: Read-only service and indexer with zero canonical execution scope

input.summary: A Python indexer, Go alert worker, and TypeScript dashboard read public chain events and never create a token, pool, hook, swap, custody path, signature, or transaction.

user.outcome: This remains a zero-scope read-only service. It needs no token, pool, hook, fake market, fee instance, wallet signing, or transaction path.
user.status: The design can proceed directly. Implementation, Application V3, deployment, provider listing, monitoring, and public availability have not started.
user.nextAction: I will define event sources, reorg recovery, freshness, alert authentication, storage, failure behavior, build profiles, tests, and the three-repository evidence closure.

facts.statement: Every component reads public chain events and produces derived notifications or displays only.
The complete graph contains no token, pool, hook, swap, pricing, custody, signing, or transaction surface.
The intended components use Python, Go, and TypeScript with language-specific reproducible build profiles.

architecture: The Python indexer reconstructs declared events, stores cursors, rolls back reorgs, and performs deterministic resync.
The Go worker consumes authenticated indexer output, deduplicates alerts, retries bounded failures, and never signs a chain transaction.
The TypeScript dashboard labels freshness, source block, confirmation policy, dependency failure, and derived rather than authoritative data.
Each repository binds its own source, lockfiles, tests, schemas, dependency closure, CI evidence, and operational assumptions.

findings.effect: Inventing a pool or fee instance would add economics and trust that the builder explicitly excluded.
findings.repair: Bind zero canonical execution scopes and keep fee instance and receipt fields null at prototype stage.

findings.effect: Read-only behavior does not remove authentication, data-integrity, reorg, retry, dependency, or recovery obligations.
findings.repair: Prove those service-specific controls instead of applying irrelevant Solidity or hook gates.

evidence.meaning: The source explicitly excludes every canonical execution and value-moving surface.
The deterministic fixture records the complete zero-scope surface claim for contract validation.
No source, build, unit, integration, reorg, retry, or end-to-end evidence exists.

gates.reason: The service remains read-only and no launch component has been invented.
The complete declared graph has zero programmable-canonical execution scopes.
Source and service-specific executable evidence have not been produced.
No exact public GitHub source revisions have been bound into an application package.
